items.prompt: A colleague calls a symmetric heavy-tailed distribution normal and uses a sample standard deviation for every risk statement. What checks are missing?
items.modelAnswer: Check support, tail evidence, model assumptions, moment existence, parameterization, dependence and estimation uncertainty. Symmetry and finite sample arithmetic establish none of those by themselves.

criteria.text: Treats finite samples and population tails as different evidence.
